raw:
@q query
  mode explain
  where match
    relation "be closed"
    role subject "the Old Mill Hall"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "be located in"
    role subject "Greenline Transport"
    role location "Bălți"
    polarity negated
  end

@q3 query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "train"
    role subject "Giorgos"
    role object ?x
    polarity affirmed
  end
